expected.body: A 52-year-old man of Northern European descent presents with bronze skin, MCP arthralgias, and fasting glucose 210 mg/dL. Transferrin saturation is 62%; HFE testing confirms C282Y homozygosity. Diagnosis: hereditary hemochromatosis; treat with therapeutic phlebotomy. Key teaching: transferrin saturation > 45% is the most sensitive screening test; MCP arthropathy responds poorly to phlebotomy.
